title: Chromatin Remodeling Protein ZmCHB101 Regulates Nitrate-Responsive Gene Expression in Maize
genotypes: WT (genetic background not stated in paper); ZmCHB101-RNAi line R101 (second RNAi line RS1 used only for phenotyping/ChIP)
stage_age: seedlings grown 7 d in nitrate-free solution ('7-day-old nitrate-free seedlings'); sampled 0 h and 2 h after nitrate supply
growth_system: hydroponic (aerated modified Hoagland); environmentally controlled growth chamber (23/18 °C, 16/8 h light/dark)
N_treatments: N-free (0 h, mock) vs 0.5 mM KNO3 for 2 h (nitrate induction)
other_factors: ZmCHB101 RNAi knockdown (core subunit of SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling complex)
timepoints_duration: 7 d nitrate starvation; 0 h vs 2 h after nitrate resupply
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq2000; layout NR; >=110 M clean reads per library
other_omics: ChIP-qPCR (H3, H3K4me3, H3K27me3; FLAG-ZmNLP3.1/ZmCHB101 in protoplasts); EMSA; dual-luciferase assays; total N, nitrate, protein, chlorophyll; NR/NiR/GS activities; qRT-PCR
key_finding: ZmCHB101 maintains nucleosomes at NREs of ZmNRT2.1/2.2, limiting ZmNLP3.1 binding; RNAi enhances low-nitrate growth
notes: RNA-seq contrasts WT vs R101 under mock and nitrate (862 and 786 DEGs); phenotyping also used 0-15 mM nitrate (5 d) and 0.5 vs 15 mM nitrate in sand (6 wk), not sequenced

title: Transcriptome Analysis of Maize Ear Leaves Treated with Long-Term Straw Return plus Nitrogen Fertilizer under the Wheat-Maize Rotation System
growth_system: field; long-term fertilization site established 2009, Laiyang, Shandong, China (36°10'N, 120°31'E); winter wheat-summer maize rotation; randomized blocks, 3 replicate plots
N_treatments: CK (no fertilizer) vs N fertilizer; SR (straw return) vs SR+N; N rate and form NR in main text (given only in Suppl. Table S4, not accessed)
other_factors: straw return (wheat and maize straw) x N fertilizer
timepoints_duration: long-term treatments (since 2009); single sampling at grain filling (sampling year NR; yields reported for 2019-2020)
bio_reps: 3 (general statement; ear leaves from 3 plants per plot)
n_libraries: 12 (computed: 4 treatments x 3 reps; not explicitly stated)
platform_layout: Illumina (WHbioacme, Wuhan); instrument and layout NR; 974.9 M clean reads in total
repository: none (data available from corresponding author on reasonable request)
other_omics: grain yield; photosynthetic gas exchange; chlorophyll, soluble sugar/protein, MDA, CAT/POD; qRT-PCR
key_finding: Straw return plus N maximized yield; 1258, 2572 and 3395 DEGs for N, SR and SRN vs CK
source_of_details: PMC full text + publisher page (MDPI, data availability statement)
notes: 4 treatments CK, SR, N, SRN; pure N contrast is N vs CK; reads mapped to B73 (~75%); no deposited raw data

title: Dual RNA-seq of maize and H. seropedicae ZAE94 association, in different doses of nitrate, reveals novel insights into Plant-PGPB-environment relationship
genotypes: SHS 5050 (Santa Helena; described both as inbred line and as triple hybrid responsive to ZAE94)
stage_age: 18 d after inoculation (4-d-old seedlings inoculated, then transferred to hydroponics)
growth_system: hydroponic (5 L containers, modified half-strength Hoagland, aerated); germination in growth chamber (30 °C); completely randomized blocks
N_treatments: LN 0.3 mM vs HN 3 mM N, supplied as nitrate (per Fig. 1 and Table 1)
other_factors: Herbaspirillum seropedicae ZAE94 (BR 11417) inoculation vs mock (sterile DYGS)
timepoints_duration: N levels applied after 6-d acclimatization; single harvest at 18 DAI (~12 d of N treatment, computed)
bio_reps: 2 sequenced per condition (5 grown; 3 used for phenotyping/qRT-PCR)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2500, paired-end (read length NR); rRNA-depleted total RNA (TruSeq Stranded Total RNA Plant depletion + NuGEN Ovation Complete Prokaryotic RNA-seq DR); 495 M PE reads in total
repository: NCBI SRA (stated in Methods; no accession given)
other_omics: bacterial transcriptome (dual RNA-seq; reads mapped to H. seropedicae Z67); biomass, shoot length, root surface area; leaf pigments; qRT-PCR; colonization qPCR
key_finding: N dose shapes maize N-metabolism, hormone and cell-wall responses to H. seropedicae; LN favored biomass, HN shoot elongation
source_of_details: PMC full text + web search (no accession found)
notes: Data Availability says data are in article/supplement; only 2 reps sequenced; complementary non-sequenced experiment used Mg(NO3)2, (NH4)2SO4 and Ca(NO3)2 as N sources

title: Nitrate and Ammonium Affect the Overall Maize Response to Nitrogen Availability by Triggering Specific and Common Transcriptional Signatures in Roots
tissue: root apex (1.5 cm from tip; pool of 20 seedlings per replicate)
stage_age: 3-d-old germinated seedlings + 24 h N-deprivation; sampled 24 h after treatment (T1)
growth_system: hydroponic (aerated nutrient solution); growth chamber (14/10 h, 25/18 °C)
N_treatments: -N (N-deprived control) vs 1 mM NO3- vs 1 mM NH4+ (salts NR), after 24 h N-free pretreatment
timepoints_duration: 24 h N-deprivation then 24 h treatment for RNA-seq; physiology at 3, 6 and 7 d
platform_layout: Illumina NextSeq500 (TruSeq RNA); layout NR; 23-35 M reads per library
other_omics: free and hydrolyzed amino acids (HILIC-MS/MS); leaf pigment indices (Dualex); biomass and root/leaf area
key_finding: Nitrate and ammonium trigger largely distinct root responses; ammonium induces hormone/stress genes, nitrate represses transmembrane transport
source_of_details: PMC full text + web search (GEO number blank in PMC text; GSE141860 series title matches paper title)
notes: 1349 NO3- and 1264 NH4+ responsive DEGs vs -N; accession found via OmicsDI series title, verify sample list

title: Comparative RNA-Seq Analysis Reveals That Regulatory Network of Maize Root Development Controls the Expression of Genes in Response to N Stress
genotypes: rtcs (rootless concerning crown and seminal roots) mutant from Maize Genetics Cooperation Stock Center (background NR); wild-type B73
stage_age: two-visible-leaf seedlings (endosperm removed) at treatment start; sampled 12, 24, 48 and 96 h after treatment
growth_system: hydroponic (2 L porcelain pots, aerated, solution renewed every other day); 28/22 °C, 14/10 h, 70% RH (facility NR)
N_treatments: normal-N 4 mM vs low-N 0.04 mM NO3- (Ca(NO3)2·4H2O; Ca balanced with CaCl2)
other_factors: rtcs mutant (lacks crown and seminal roots)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2500, PE125 (NEBNext Ultra library; Novogene)
other_omics: root morphology (primary and lateral root length); total protein; GS activity; qRT-PCR
key_finding: rtcs-dependent root-development network (AP2-EREBP, LBD) also regulates N-deficiency genes; NRT2.1/NAR2 higher in rtcs at normal N
source_of_details: PMC full text + MaizeGDB RNA-seq metadata file (accession only)
notes: Accession not in PMC text; taken from MaizeGDB Hartford_MaizeGDB-2024 metadata (which lists B73 roots), so confirm rtcs runs are in PRJNA304223; samples coded RNI-IV, RLI-IV, WNI-IV, WLI-IV
